notes: GAAP. Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers/fund balances from the Governmental Funds statements (trimmed pp5-6, Total Governmental Funds column); identity reconciles (6,630,210 + 9,193,580 - 10,643,880 + 2,848,638 - 3,988,616 = 4,039,932). Taxes 4,288,935 split into property 2,200,410 and local option sales 2,088,525 using the Statement of Activities (p3). Miscellaneous 242,012 split into Keno 195,577 (Other Governmental Funds column, matches Keno proceeds on p3) and General Fund other revenues 46,435 (p13). Business-type from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p9, Totals column): receipts = operating 2,550,360 + nonoperating grants 39,179,759 + interest 5,334 + other 18,140; disbursements = operating expenses 3,011,624 + interest expense 34,714; transfers in 1,139,978 from governmental (governmental net transfers -1,139,978 matches). Business-type roll-forward reconciles. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (pp1-2); sales tax payable put under due to other governments, customers' deposits under other liabilities. ending_cash is Cash and cash equivalents on the Governmental Funds balance sheet (p4; excludes county treasurer cash 69,134 and restricted cash 1,632,081). Detail is the General Fund schedule only (pp13-16); the object lines (Personnel services etc.) are mapped to object categories, 'Administrative and general' as not itemized; function placement follows the schedule's department, with cemetery and senior center as health/welfare. Capital outlay and debt service inside General Fund departments are in the detail only; the statement shows them as separate lines. The combined budgetary-basis all-funds statement (p12, cash-basis budgetary figures, mixes governmental and business-type funds) is not recorded in detail to avoid mixing fund types and double counting; its totals (receipts 48,471,390; disbursements 61,252,487) do not tie to the GAAP statements. The proprietary cash flow reconciliation (p11, gained in the v8 re-trim) confirms net cash from operating activities (104,206) Totals; nothing new. Read pages 1-16 of 16

decision_needed.question: General Fund schedule (p15) prints Cemetery (219,704) and Senior Citizen Center (208,125) under the Culture and Recreation function (Public Health and Welfare total is 95,826, animal control only; p5 Culture and Recreation 1,627,020 includes them). The category rules map cemetery and senior services to health/welfare, so detail lines use health/welfare. Should the printed function heading (culture/recreation) govern instead?
decision_needed.recorded_as: detail[51]-[55] and detail[65]-[69], category health/welfare (top-level disbursements keep printed Culture and Recreation)
